description: This Java class 'TemplateMapper' defines an entity for mapping template keys and values with an order, used within the Apache Fineract project. It extends a custom persistable class and is mapped to the database table 'm_templatemappers'.

classes.name: TemplateMapper
classes.description: An entity representing a template mapping with key, value, and order properties, mapped to 'm_templatemappers' table.

methods.name: TemplateMapper(int, String, String)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the mapper with order, key, and value.

methods.name: getMapperkey()
methods.description: Returns the key of the template mapping.

methods.name: getMapperorder()
methods.description: Returns the order of the template mapping.

methods.name: setMapperorder(int)
methods.description: Sets the order of the template mapping.

methods.name: setMapperkey(String)
methods.description: Sets the key of the template mapping.

methods.name: getMappervalue()
methods.description: Returns the value of the template mapping.

methods.name: setMappervalue(String)
methods.description: Sets the value of the template mapping.
